{{Quote|The star that the planet Corellia goes around is called ''Corell'', and that's where all the other things with the word 'Corell' in them get their name. But no one ever calls that star 'Corell.' Everyone does what everyone does everywhere else and just calls it 'the sun.' Everyone always does that.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Ambush">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Corell''', known simply as "'''the sun'''" to inhabitants of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] and the primary sun of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="Ambush" /> It was orbited by seven worlds,<ref name="tea" /> five of which could sustain life. The [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], system and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] all took their names from the star.<ref name="Ambush" />
